scope: owner tool tracks requested unique allocation payload at instrumented sites only; this is not total physical RAM or graph/driver backing. Host MemAvailable and tegrastats remain separately preserved in each cell.

cells.graph_bytes: unsupported; counts do not measure driver or graph-pool bytes
